rationale: The Court is likely to hold that § 1108(b)(2)(A) is a separately codified exemption that defendants must raise and prove, so plaintiffs need not plead unreasonableness or lack of necessity to state a § 1106(a)(1)(C) claim. A lone Alito dissent is likely to argue Twombly/Iqbal plausibility and workability require some allegation that the contract falls outside the safe harbor, with possible concurrences emphasizing early dismissal when the exemption is apparent on the face of the complaint.
